$comment: Maps a Fanvue icon component name to its lucide-animated registry slug
Only add an entry when the animated artwork is the SAME GLYPH as our static icon —
the animated subpath re-exports our name, so consumers swap the import path and
expect the same picture at the same size. Pairs in 'icons' were verified by
rendering both side by side. 'review' holds plausible pairs where the artwork
differs (fill vs stroke, mirrored, extra element); move an entry up into 'icons'
once a designer signs it off, then re-run `pnpm icons:animated`.

review.$comment: Not generated. Each line records why the pair is not a straight swap.
review.CheckCircleIcon: circle-check — ours is a solid disc with a knockout check, animated art is an outline
review.DonateIcon: hand-coins — ours adds a sparkle above the hand
review.EyeClosedIcon: eye-off — ours slashes a circle rather than the eye
review.EyeSlashIcon: eye-off — ours slashes a circle rather than the eye
review.FacebookIcon: facebook — ours is a filled roundel, animated art is an outline glyph
review.GridViewIcon: layout-grid — ours uses filled squares, animated art is outlined
review.LogoutIcon: logout — arrow points the opposite way in the animated art
review.MessageIcon: message-circle-more — ours adds a heart badge above the bubble
review.PhoneOffIcon: phone-missed — same handset-with-x artwork, different semantics
review.ReceiveMoneyIcon: hand-coins — ours holds a dollar sign rather than coins
review.SuccessIcon: circle-check — ours is a solid disc with a knockout check
review.UserAddIcon: user-round-plus — ours encloses the figure in a circle
